turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi Daniel, this is Maya Chen from SignalDesk. You booked time to talk about support automation. Is now still a good time?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, it is. I do have a hard stop in about twelve minutes, though.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Understood. Before we begin, are you comfortable with this call being recorded for quality and note taking?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that's fine, as long as payment information is not captured or repeated back to me.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Agreed. I won't ask for card numbers, passwords, or banking details. To start, what is creating the most pressure for your support team?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We process roughly eighteen thousand tickets a month across email, chat, and WhatsApp. Weekend first response is close to eleven hours, and reporting is split between Zendesk and an internal portal.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: So the immediate goals are faster weekend coverage, one reporting layer, and fewer manual handoffs. Did I capture that correctly?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Mostly. Add multilingual routing. We support English, Spanish, and Portuguese, and the Portuguese queue is where we miss the most service level targets.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's helpful. SignalDesk can route by language, synchronize through a REST A P I, and use single sign on through S A M L. We can also flag conversations that need a human supervisor.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I need to slow down there. Do you store message content? Our legal team requires European Union data residency, an S O C two Type Two report, and deletion requests completed within thirty days.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The European region and configurable retention are available. The S O C two Type Two report can be shared under a nondisclosure agreement. I do need our solutions engineer to confirm how WhatsApp media attachments are handled, so I don't want to guess.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Good. I appreciate the honest answer. HelpSphere told us everything was covered, and then the security review found three exceptions.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That is exactly why I would bring a technical specialist into the next conversation. May I ask how many users would be included in the first phase?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Two hundred and fifty seats. Procurement wants an annual agreement, but finance has capped the first year at three thousand eight hundred dollars per month.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Our standard enterprise rate is eighteen dollars per user per month on an annual term. For two hundred and fifty seats, that is four thousand five hundred dollars monthly before any pilot discount.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is above the cap. HelpSphere quoted thirty-six hundred, although they do not support Portuguese routing. Can you get to thirty-seven fifty?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I cannot approve that number myself. A fifteen percent pilot discount would bring the monthly amount to three thousand eight hundred and twenty-five dollars for the first ninety days. I can ask my director whether there is room to close the remaining seventy-five dollar gap.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, but please do not describe that as approved. My vice president of finance still has the final decision, and the security questionnaire comes first.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Absolutely. The proposal will label the discount as pending approval. What implementation date are you targeting if the review goes well?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We would like the pilot live by September first. Is three weeks realistic?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Three weeks is realistic after the security review is complete and the A P I credentials are available. It is not a guaranteed launch date until both dependencies are cleared.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fair enough. Let's schedule a technical workshop. I can do Wednesday, July twenty-second at two thirty P M Eastern. Sorry, I just checked my calendar. Make that Thursday, July twenty-third at two thirty P M Eastern.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thursday, July twenty-third at two thirty P M Eastern. I will invite a solutions engineer and send the security pack beforehand. Which address should I use for this test?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Use the fictional alias daniel dot pilot at blueharbor dot example. The internal reference is B H dash seven zero four dash B.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Got it. I will send the security questionnaire, the pending-price proposal, and the workshop invitation today. To be clear, no purchase has been approved yet.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Correct. We are interested, but the decision depends on security, the final price, and Portuguese routing. If those three items check out, I will recommend moving forward.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That gives us a clear plan. Thanks, Daniel. I will see you at the technical workshop next Thursday.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thanks, Maya. I will watch for the documents.
